title.point: God plans to reach the right people, even an entire household, for His plan. We can believe He wants to save whole families.

thisWeekSong.title: In the Whole Universe God Has a Household

lyricsCentered.text:
In the whole universe God has a household.
A sweet, unique, and wonderful family.

My family,
Your family,
God’s family.

God chose the best for us; we are so happy here!
He chose my family; He chose your family.

Look to your left!
Look to your right!
We belong here!

lastWeekSong.title: Move with God, Wherever He Leads Us

lyricsLeft.text: Move with God, wherever He leads us,
Move with God, wherever He guides.
Move with God, He knows where He needs us,
Move with God, however He guides.
Obeyed God to follow His call.

lyricsRight.text: God told Moses, “Go out of Egypt,
Take My people out of that place.
Build the house in the way that I tell you,
Follow Me in all that I say.”
Mom and Dad, now follow God’s leading,
We’re on earth to move on with Him.
He will show us how we should follow,
Just obey in all that He speaks.

lastWeekReview.title: Journeying by Following the Cloud
bullets: As Israel journeyed to the good land, they had no map and no GPS — God Himself was their GUIDE!
God dwelt in the tabernacle, and a CLOUD rested over it to show the people the way.
When the cloud LIFTED and moved, Israel set out. When it settled, they stopped and camped.
They didn’t move whenever they felt like it — they moved only when GOD moved.
Because they followed the cloud, even millions of people stayed in perfect ORDER, family by family.
Today God guides us through our “cloud” — our parents and serving ones who FOLLOW Him.
lastWeekReview.discussion: Did you follow your “cloud” this week — obeying your parents or serving ones right away, even when you wanted to do your own thing? Share how it went!
lastWeekReview.verseQuote: “But it is Jehovah who is going before you… He will not fail you nor forsake you.” — Deuteronomy 31:8

kidsContent.text: As Israel took the land God gave them, they had to fight many battles. One very important battle was to take the city of JERICHO — and in that city lived one woman God had a special plan for!

Before the battle, Joshua sent two men as spies to view the land and the city. The two spies came to the house of a woman named Rahab — a woman who had not lived a good life, but who believed in the true God.

When the king of Jericho heard spies were in the city, he sent word to Rahab to hand them over. Instead, Rahab HID the two spies on her roof under stalks of flax, and told the king’s men she didn’t know where they had gone.

Rahab and the spies made an oath: she would protect them, and they would rescue her whole family when Israel destroyed the city. Her house was on the city wall, so she let the spies down by a rope through her window — and tied a SCARLET cord there as the sign to keep her family safe.
🌟 Rahab was not from Israel, yet she believed that the God of Israel is the one true God in heaven above and on the earth beneath!

image.caption: Rahab hides the two spies and lets them down by a scarlet cord

kidsContent.text: It seems those two spies were sent by God especially to find Rahab and her family! Why would God reach out to someone who had done wrong? Because God had a PLAN for her.
Rahab turned to the children of Israel and to their God, and she put her trust in Him. Because she believed, God saved her AND her entire household from the destruction of Jericho.
Later Rahab married Salmon, a leader in the tribe of Judah, and became part of Israel. In fact, because of her faith she became one of the main ancestors of Jesus — what a plan God had for her!
🌟 God plans to reach the right people, even a whole household. We can believe He wants to save our WHOLE family too!

lesson.practicePoint: This week, believe that God wants to save your WHOLE family! Pray for each person in your household by name, and thank God that His plan is big enough to reach every one of them.

memoryVerse.text: …For Jehovah your God, He is God in heaven above and upon earth beneath.
memoryVerse.application: Rahab was not from Israel, yet she believed that the God of Israel is the one true God over heaven and earth. And because she believed, God saved her whole family! God wants to reach and save whole households — including yours.

activity.title: 🧵 The Scarlet Cord — Gather the Household

parts.text: Materials: A long red yarn or ribbon (the “scarlet cord”), a “window” marked on a wall or chair, and a taped-off area on the floor to be “Rahab’s house.”
Setup: Tie or tape the scarlet cord at the “window.” Explain that everyone safe inside the house when the city falls will be rescued — just like Rahab’s family!

Round 1 — Hide the Spies: Two kids are the spies. The rest cover their eyes while the spies hide “on the roof.” When the leader (the king’s men) calls, everyone must stay quiet and NOT give the spies away.
Round 2 — Tie the Cord: The spies “escape” past the window and hand the scarlet cord to Rahab, who ties it up. Cheer — the sign of rescue is set!

Round 3 — Gather the Family: On “Jericho is falling!” every child races to get INSIDE the scarlet-cord house before the leader counts to ten. Everyone inside is saved together — a whole household rescued!
📖 Connection: Rahab believed God and gathered her whole family under the scarlet cord to be safe. God plans to save whole households — He wants your family gathered in too!

rolePlayScript.text: Scene: Inside Rahab’s house, built right on the wall of Jericho. It is night. Two Israelite spies have just slipped in through the door.

Before Israel entered the land, Joshua sent two spies to view the city of Jericho. They came to the house of a woman named Rahab — a woman who had not lived a good life, but who believed in the true God.
Please — we are men of Israel, sent to view this land. Can you keep us safe tonight?
Come in, quickly! I have heard how your God dried up the Red Sea. I believe He is the true God — the God of heaven above and the earth below.
A loud banging on the door. It is the king’s messengers.
Rahab! Open up! The king says spies from Israel are hiding in your house. Bring them out at once!
Spies? Oh yes, some men came — but they already left at dark, before the gate closed. Hurry, and you may catch them on the road!
But Rahab had hidden the two spies up on her roof, under stalks of flax laid out to dry. The king’s men rushed off the wrong way.
You risked everything to protect us. How can we repay you?
When your people come to take this city, please spare me — and my father, my mother, my brothers, my whole family!
We give you our oath. Tie this scarlet cord in your window. Gather your whole household inside, and everyone under this sign will be saved.
Rahab lowers the spies by a rope through the window, then ties the scarlet cord in its place.
The scarlet cord is tied. Father, Mother, come — everyone must stay inside with me. God is going to save our whole family!
And He did! When Jericho fell, Rahab and her entire household were rescued. Later she married into Israel and became one of the ancestors of Jesus — the right person for God’s plan.
God plans to save whole families — we believe He wants to save our household too!

description.text: Setup: Stretch a long red rope or ribbon across the floor to mark “Rahab’s house.” Everyone starts scattered around the room as Rahab’s family, out in the city.
Rules: When the leader calls “Jericho is falling!” every child must race INSIDE the scarlet cord before the leader counts down from ten. Everyone inside in time is “saved” together.
Out: Anyone still outside the cord at zero does 5 jumping jacks, then rejoins for the next round — nobody is left out for good!
Twist: Each round the leader counts faster, and the family must help each other — call out and pull the slow ones in, because a whole household gets rescued together.
📖 Connection: Rahab gathered her whole family under the scarlet cord to be safe. God plans to save whole households — He wants your family gathered in!
Materials: A long red rope or ribbon, open floor space
Setup: Split into two “houses.” Each house picks two “spies” and marks a hidden “roof” spot (behind a chair or a taped square).
Rules: On “Go!”, each team must quietly guide their two spies to the roof and cover them (with a light cloth of “flax”), then all sit down silently.
Scoring: The first house with BOTH spies fully hidden and the whole team sitting quietly wins the round — noise or a peeking spy means try again.
Switch: Rotate who plays the spies each round so everyone gets a turn to hide and to help.
📖 Connection: Rahab hid the spies because she believed in the true God. Because of her faith, God saved her whole family — He wants to save yours too!
Materials: Two light cloths or towels (the “flax”), chairs or floor markers
Mark one tree, fence, or corner as “Rahab’s house” and tie a red ribbon there as the scarlet cord. Everyone else spreads out across the yard as the household.
Goal: When the leader shouts “The city is falling!”, everyone must run and touch the scarlet cord before the count of ten — the whole family safe together.
Rule: Big kids help little kids get there in time — no one runs only for themselves, because God saves whole households, not just one person.
Finish: Gather at the safe house and thank God that He plans to reach and save whole families — including ours.
Materials: A red ribbon or cloth, and an open outdoor space with one clear “home” landmark

outdoor.tip: 🧵 The lesson is God’s heart to save whole households: even someone who had done wrong, like Rahab, was reached because she believed. Help the kids feel that God’s plan is big enough for every person in their family.
